contractName.description: A name for the contract in your seller records.

partnerUsername.description: The Explodely affiliate ID of the partner.

product.description: The Explodely product ID or allproducts.

commission.description: The percentage of your share the partner will get, up to 80.

startDate.description: Optional start date in dd-mmm-yyyy format.

endDate.description: Optional end date in dd-mmm-yyyy format.

comments.description: Optional comments shown in the seller contracts section.

activate.description: Set to yes to activate the contract immediately.

mutualTermination.description: Set to yes to require both parties to approve termination.
